topics.title: Quantum optimization libraries compared: QAOA, QUBO, and annealing
Quantum computing software in 2026: the open-source map

whatItIs: grove is an open-source project in the optimization and qubo category. It is maintained by rigetticomputing and primarily looks like a Python codebase. Quantum algorithms built using pyQuil.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches optimization and qubo workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: A collection of quantum algorithms built using the Rigetti Forest platform. Grove is licensed under the Apache 2.0 license. The Variational-Quantum-Eigensolver (VQE) The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) The Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) Phase Estimation Algorithm
whoItsFor: Teams exploring routing, scheduling, allocation, and other combinatorial problems that can be modeled as optimization workloads.
whatYouCanBuild: Understand how this project models constrained optimization problems.
Compare QUBO, QAOA, and hybrid optimization workflows against classical baselines.
